tw: In a trance on a tram roof, Kron transcends, ascending past ten bending tents.
twc: Kron 在电车顶上入定，超脱升空，飘过十顶被风吹弯的帐篷。
hint: 别人搭帐篷，他直接升天。

tw: Cynical Kron sniffs a cinnamon bun at the sink and squints, 'A sinful trick, I think.'
twc: 多疑的 Kron 在水槽边闻肉桂卷，眯眼：“罪恶的陷阱。”

tw: Eccentric Kron spends ten cents teaching a centipede a tricky trick.
twc: 怪人 Kron 花十分钱，教一只蜈蚣耍一个高难度把戏。
hint: 全场都看呆，只有他当真。

tw: Egotistical Kron goes on tiptoe to kiss his own artistic statue and tickle its chin.
twc: 自大的 Kron 踮脚亲吻自己的艺术雕像，还挠挠它下巴。
hint: 世上最美的作品是他自己。

tw: A gull sells gullible Kron a bubble, and Kron gulps the bubble whole.
twc: 海鸥卖给好骗的 Kron 一个泡泡，Kron 一口吞了。
hint: 花钱买空气，还吃下去了。

tw: In his idealised idea, Kron rides a giant eel; in real size, the eel rides Kron.
twc: Kron 理想中骑着巨鳗，现实中是小鳗鱼骑着他。

tw: Inconsiderate Kron sits on Sid the rat's cinema seat inside the inn.
twc: 不体贴的 Kron 在旅馆的放映厅里，霸占了老鼠小希的座位。

tw: Indecisive Kron sighs, can't decide: this slice of pie, or that size?
twc: 犹豫不决的 Kron 叹气：要这块派，还是那么大的？

tw: Self-absorbed Kron snaps a selfie with a shiny orb as the shelf falls behind him.
twc: 自恋的 Kron 举着亮球自拍，身后整排架子轰然倒下。

tw: Self-congratulatory Kron grabs a great rat-sized trophy and pats himself: lots of glory!
twc: 自鸣得意的 Kron 抓起老鼠那么大的奖杯，拍拍自己：真光荣！

tw: Self-deprecating Kron skates off the deck, then jokes, 'Just checking the depth!'
twc: 爱自嘲的 Kron 滑板冲出平台掉进水里，笑说：“我在测水深！”

tw: Self-important Kron pours tea for the important portrait of himself at the port.
twc: 自视甚高的 Kron 在港口给自己的巨幅肖像倒茶。

tw: Tactful Kron taps the cat on the cactus and says, 'In fact, that's fully prickly.'
twc: 得体的 Kron 轻拍趴在仙人掌上的猫：“其实，这挺扎的。”

tw: Well-adjusted Kron just dusts his hat when the rusted well bucket busts.
twc: 适应力强的 Kron，生锈的井桶破了，他只是掸掸帽子上的灰。

tw: Well-bred Kron spreads butter on bread in bed with his little finger up.
twc: 有教养的 Kron 在床上给面包抹黄油，小指翘得老高。
hint: 床上吃早饭也得翘小指。

tw: Well-brought-up Kron taught the naughty dog he brought up to bow and say please.
twc: 有家教的 Kron 教他养大的调皮狗鞠躬说“请”。

tw: Kron finds nine fine finds behind the mine, all in a line.
twc: Kron 在矿井后面挖到九件精美文物，整整齐齐排成一排。

tw: Kron remembers his cake, but finds only remnants and ten ants having a party.
twc: Kron 想起他的蛋糕，回来只剩残渣和十只开派对的蚂蚁。

tw: In retrospect, Kron regrets resting his wet head on a speckled egg.
twc: 事后想想，Kron 后悔把湿脑袋枕在一只斑点蛋上。

tw: Kron's abrupt burp erupts, and the bubble cup jumps up.
twc: Kron 突然打了个响嗝，桌上的泡泡杯都蹦了起来。
